output.summary: Approved G1031 design revision 2: one rule across SKILL step 7, SETUP, REPAIR and MIGRATING: auto-delete head branches on without settings.branching, off with it, because merging G1025's finish PR (head = the kept release/N or hotfix/x branch) would delete the branch, and it races stacked-PR retargeting. validate adds a non-gating auto_delete_head_branches warning when branching is set and the setting reads on (10 s gh probe, silent when unreadable). REPAIR restores a deleted line branch from the line goal's recorded tip. Review approved after one round; note for G1025: finish should record its tip before merging.

responses.review_design:1:1: fixed: stated as the primary reason in SKILL step 7, SETUP, MIGRATING and the warning message; REPAIR entry restores release/N or hotfix/x via git push <R> <recorded tip>:refs/heads/<branch>; a test asserts the warning names release/ and hotfix/ branches; the probe gets a 10 s timeout (Gh.run optional timeout).

output.summary: Revision 2. Adds the stronger reason for turning auto-delete off with settings.branching: merging G1025's finish PR (head release/N or hotfix/x itself) deletes the kept line branch and can break hotfix back-merges mid-finish. The reason now appears in SKILL/SETUP/MIGRATING and in the validate warning text; REPAIR gains an entry restoring the branch from the line goal's recorded tip. The probe uses a 10 s timeout instead of 60 s, and tests cover the warning text and the timeout case.

findings.text: F1: auto-delete also deletes G1025's kept line branches at finish, and the design omits it. G1025 rev3 §6 step 1 opens the finish PR with head release/N itself ('the branch itself, no copy') and merges it into production, and §7 does the same for hotfix/x. With 'Automatically delete head branches' on, GitHub deletes that head on merge. That removes release/N (kept by O3) and hotfix/x (kept by D14). For hotfixes, the later back-merges into dev and the release branch may then fail, and G1025 §4's missing-branch check raises 'gone from origin' mid-finish. This is a stronger reason for 'off' than the stacked-PR race, which G1025 already recovers from. Fix: name it in the SKILL/SETUP/MIGRATING 'why' and in the warning message; add a REPAIR entry that restores the branch from the line goal's recorded tip (git push origin <tip>:refs/heads/<branch>); and have the root note to G1025's implement that finish's back-merges use the recorded tip sha, not the branch name. Test that the warning text names release/hotfix branches.

output.summary: Approved. review_design:1:1 is resolved: deleting a kept release/N or hotfix/x branch through the finish PR is now the primary reason in SKILL step 7 (marker phrase kept), SETUP, MIGRATING and the warning message. REPAIR restores the branch from the recorded tip, G1025's implementer was told to use recorded tips, and a test pins the warning text. The probe now has a 10 s timeout through an optional Gh.run parameter, with a timeout test. No owner question.

spec:
Found while designing G1003 (2026-11-01). Bootstrap step 7 says to turn GitHub's "Automatically delete head branches" on, while G1025 (release branching) recommends it off in branching repositories, because deleting a dependency's branch on merge closes or retargets stacked and release PRs. Make the bootstrap skill and REPAIR/MIGRATING say: on without settings.branching, off with it, and why; validate warns when branching is configured and auto-delete is on (if readable).

Acceptance: skill text and a validate warning test (or a documented reason the setting is unreadable); docs/design edits per G1017's rule.
title: Bootstrap's branch-deletion advice must match release branching
